nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/user_turns_all.md — the corpus: 920 human-authored user turns, chronological, verbatim text with no edits. The only source of intent in the project. 5,187 lines, 32 active days, 2026-05-14 12:30 → 2026-08-05 14:43, desktop 127 + laptop 793

Corpus format and how to cite it. Each turn is a `## <YYYY-MM-DD> <HH:MM> · <machine> · <session-uuid>.jsonl` heading followed by the verbatim turn text; pasted material is marked `*paste / file drop · N chars*`. Citations across docs/canon/ take the form turns:L<line> = the line in this .md rendering. The machine-readable twin is user_turns_all.jsonl, one JSON object per turn carrying uuid, iso_timestamp, machine and text, and it is what the CQ search in REVIEW_WORKLIST.md reads. The file is evidence and read-only — re-derive with tools/canon_extract.py, never edit

Corpus band 2026-05-14 → 05-28, L7-L211, 20 turns, desktop. The project's first surviving chat. Onboarding and the frontend/graph wiring; the quarantine instruction that the originals are boxed and only copies rewritten HERB-only; keeping claude alongside gpt for model comparison; and the two thin days 05-27 and 05-28 carrying one turn each. Everything before 05-14 survives only as state in git

Corpus band 2026-06-27 → 07-02, L215-L470, 52 turns, desktop — the chat record resumes after the 29-day blackout. 06-27 (L215-L312): the shape of the facets for v3, facets as themed RELEVANCE weights, the multi-step relevance concept, no LLM judge in the creation of tags/facets, and the k-sweep order to gather all the data for the named k's. 06-30 (L316-L448): not overfitting to the specific dataset; "the actual content should never exist in the graph at all" (L538 restates it on 07-06); the relationships pivot — half the strength of a graph is routing on relationships instead of structures; reviving the herb-eval graph and running the current arm at k=50 on it; the exponential evaluation-curve with exact = max; fuzzy meaning embedded. 07-01 (L452-L462): "Dont think herb, think dataset agnostic concept"

Corpus band 2026-07-06, L474-L659, 44 turns — the day the v1 concept is restated in full and the arm is renamed. Holds the fullest single statement of the v1 concept in the corpus (file → chunks → tags, chunk description and relational weight to file, tags with relational values, facet-values on tags, all of it embedded, no content in the graph); "but the actual content should never exist in the graph at all, and we fixed that by just making pointers again, right?" (L538); facets ride one edge, chunk→tag, and there are only five; re-embed exactly what was embedded before with nemotron and nothing more; the arm named artefact_v1 rather than herb_eval; and securing the 100 gold answers with all metrics before running the eval

Corpus band 2026-07-15 → 07-19, L675-L1459, 171 turns. 07-15 (L675-L873): the four-point rejection of the gate — guidance and rankings instead of hard filters, and clustering of areas to widen weak hits; "i do NOT like arbitrary choices for k or any number or value, fucking BASE it on something, i kinda like knn clustering for relevance spheres" (L779); overfitting named as the standing risk; "there is only HERB dataset, forget everything else"; and the multihop-by-design question. 07-16 (L877-L1188, 61 turns): trust revoked after an agent implemented and pushed an accidental plan; an opinion is never a command; he runs the scripts; visible progress demanded and asked to be written into the .md; the haiku judge tried first; env and Neo4j facts. 07-17 (L1192-L1302): the first usage catastrophe and reusable tools, not one-off scripts. 07-18 → 07-19 (L1306-L1459): qwen's speed, and the benchmark construction discussion

Corpus band 2026-07-20 → 07-23, L1463-L2639, 225 turns — the densest stretch in the corpus. 07-20 (L1463-L1961, 64 turns): the vocabulary reclaimed — the concepts he was interested in were the fuzzy clustering and the levels of k's, and NNK pruning / fusion arrangement / gap cut are none of them; is the graph actually built in a way that makes use of the qualities of a graph; how the fuck are facets used here then. 07-21 (L1966-L2278, 74 turns): clustering IS embedding distances against each other, not rankings or countings; "why did you make up a number like 200 here?"; the clusters are based on the actual shit from the prompt, so you cant pre-run it..? (L1988); cluster-K defined as the curve of best fit deciding the correct K; USE ALL THE FUCKING DATA IN THE FUCKING GRAPH; the arms-as-tool-calls idea raised and parked. 07-22 (L2282-L2443): orchestrator mode adopted, the adversarial panel ordered then its seeding condemned and a blind control ordered, the toggle rule, and "i dont think the walk and the 'best fit' is helping eachother, you?". 07-23 (L2447-L2639): the un-normalized summation caught, the hybrid arm ordered, commit means push, precompute everything, and the usage burn
